data.title: Japan sends senior diplomat to Russia over detained journalist
data.description: TOKYO — Japan sent a senior diplomat to Moscow this week to discuss the release of a journalist detained by Russia on spying accusations, Tokyo said on Wednesday.

data.title: Record-late 30°C heat grips wide swathe of Japan
data.description: KYODO — A wide swath of Japan faced sweltering heat on Wednesday, with temperatures in some regions recording the latest day in the year to top 30 degrees Celsius, prompting many to switch back to summer clothes for the day.

data.title: Nominee hunt targets Chon Buri properties worth B800m
data.description: CHON BURI - Police raided 12 properties worth a combined 800 million baht in Bang Lamung district on Wednesday morning, suspecting them of being illegally owned by foreigners.

data.title: Norwegian fugitive wanted for attempted murder arrested
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN - Thai authorities are preparing to deport a 19-year-old Norwegian man wanted on attempted murder charges in his home country after arresting him on Wednesday.

data.title: OCEAN LIFE reimagines insurance for the living
data.description: Thailand’s insurance industry has demonstrated resilience amid global uncertainties through the second quarter of 2026, with the t otal life insurance premiums in the first half in 2026 reached THB 341.52 billion, up 4.57% year on year, in which the Thai Life Assurance Association forecasting full-year growth of 2.5–3.5%. Against this challenging backdrop, OCEAN LIFE INSURANCE is seeing a shift in consumer awareness, with life insurance increasingly linked to digitalisation, longer and healthier lives and more sophisticated wealth management.

data.title: North Korea says 'new firepower units' in place after border threat
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea has moved new units into "firing positions", the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong Un said Wednesday, days after Pyongyang warned it was considering deploying additional strike means to its border with South Korea.

data.title: Activist group says grey business crackdown falling short
data.description: A political activist group has urged national police chief Samran Nualma to step up efforts to crack down on grey businesses, scam gangs and online gambling — and on the public officials who turn a blind eye to illegality.

data.title: UK approves new North Sea gas drilling
data.description: LONDON - The UK government said on Wednesday that it had approved plans to begin drilling in a controversial new gas field in the North Sea, ending months of speculation about the future of the site.

data.title: 'Daily struggle': Cubans dig wells in search of water
data.description: HAVANA — Kevin Martinez has come up with a creative new way to avoid shutting his restaurant when water runs low in Cuba, a common source of frustration for the business owner.

data.title: Germany–Japan–Thailand Investment Corridor Could Unlock Thai Industrial Growth
data.description: Thailand could gain new investment, cleaner industrial technology and stronger regional supply chains through closer cooperation with Germany and Japan, provided the three countries translate shared ambitions into commercially viable projects.

data.title: Gaysorn Group wins Marshall Goldsmith Coaching Culture Excellence Award Thailand 2026
data.description: Gaysorn Group has received the “Marshall Goldsmith Coaching Culture Excellence Award Thailand 2026,” presented by Dr Marshall Goldsmith in collaboration with ITD World, the award organiser and endorsed by a panel of global experts. As the first and only organisation in Thailand to receive this distinction, Gaysorn Group has demonstrated its commitment to developing people’s capabilities and growth, while embedding a coaching culture into everyday work to build high-performance teams and drive sustainable growth.

data.title: Record-Low Top University Acceptance Rates
data.description: Gaining admission to world-class universities like the Ivy League, Stanford, or Oxbridge today is no longer just a competition of academic excellence. No matter how stellar a student's grades are, the risk of rejection remains. With top-tier applicants possessing remarkably similar abilities, the deciding factor is no longer who is smarter, but "who has a clearer and more standout identity."

data.title: Malaysia bans civil servants from using Israeli mapping app
data.description: KUALA ​LUMPUR — Malaysia has banned civil servants ​from using Alphabet's navigation application Waze after Prime ​Minister Anwar Ibrahim ‌said its origins in Israel raised security concerns.

data.title: PM’s new narcotics bill equates possession with trafficking
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has submitted amendment bills that would intensify drug suppression through longer detention, greater data access for authorities and a redefinition of all drug possessors as traffickers.

data.title: Bangkok college move to go ahead, says minister
data.description: Higher Education Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat has confirmed plans to relocate a central Bangkok vocational college at the centre of decades-old land dispute, despite student protests, pledging support to minimise disruption during the 90-day transition.

data.title: Thai series link fan loyalty to merchandise and tourism
data.description: Thai series could drive merchandise sales and tourism, but Nation Forum speakers warn that funding and crew welfare need attention

data.title: SBS Rangsit Launches International Bilingual Model for Thai Students
data.description: As Thailand’s international education market grows, SBS International Bilingual School Rangsit is advancing an approach designed to bridge international academic standards with the language skills, cultural understanding and practical experience students need for their futures in Thailand and around the world.

data.title: Suvarnabhumi denies online claim of luggage search
data.description: Suvarnabhumi airport has said it has not found any evidence that its staff opened and searched a passenger’s luggage, responding to a Thai travel blogger who claimed online that her belongings had been rummaged through.

data.title: LeBron, Sixers spoil Knicks party, Thunder top Spurs as NBA season tips off
data.description: NEW YORK - LeBron James and his new Philadelphia 76ers teammates crashed the New York Knicks' season-opening celebrations on Tuesday, beating the defending NBA champions 106-100 on the night they raised their title banner at Madison Square Garden.

data.title: Customs seize 1,000 Apple phones
data.description: TAK: Customs officers have seized 1,000 second-hand Apple phones worth more than 7 million baht suspected of being smuggled into Myanmar.

data.title: World falling 'dangerously short' on climate action: UN chief
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Global commitments to cut planet-heating emissions are falling far short of the Paris climate goals and put the world on course for 2.6C warming this century, the UN warned on Wednesday.

data.title: South Korea launches new bid to guide crowd-pulling shark to sea
data.description: SEOUL - South Korean authorities began a new attempt Wednesday to coax a shark-turned-viral sensation back to sea, with falling temperatures in the Busan canal where it is stranded raising concerns for its survival.

data.title: US envoy to meet Russia's president after 'productive' talks with Zelensky
data.description: SAINT PETERSBURG — US envoy Steve Witkoff will travel to Saint Petersburgand meet Russian President Vladimir Putin on Wednesday following "very productive" talks with Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky.

data.title: Two drug suspects killed in shootout with police in Phetchaburi
data.description: PHETCHABURI - Two suspected drug smugglers were killed and 500 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine seized following an exchange of gunfire with narcotics suppression police in Khao Yoi district on Tuesday night.

data.title: Parts of Bangkok and 19 provinces remain flooded
data.description: Floods persisted in parts of Bangkok and 19 provinces, mostly in the Central Plains, on Wednesday, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: French PM to meet unions as government prepares for more protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - France's prime minister plans to meet unions on Wednesday to discuss security and has vowed a "massive" police deployment at protests, following riots in the past week that led to curfews and arrests.

data.title: NBTC Symposium 2026 tackles digital resilience and emerging technologies
data.description: On October 8–9, 2026, the Office of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC), through the International Academic Affairs Bureau under the Academic Affairs Division, successfully hosted the NBTC Symposium 2026 at the Viman Room, Dusit Thani Bangkok Hotel. The opening ceremony was presided over by Ms. Korkanok Kijbanjai, Principal Policy and Planning Expert with Ramida Leelapata, Assistant Secretary General of Academic Cluster delivering the reporting overview. The event convened ambassadors and members of the diplomatic corps in Thailand, representatives from international organizations, government agencies, the private sector, academic institutions, as well as NBTC executives and personnel. The symposium served as a high-level platform for knowledge exchange and vision sharing among senior executives from leading domestic and international public and private sectors, under the theme “Beyond Volatility: Harnessing Resilience Through Dialogue.”
